name: Kankin Idol Recital ~Idol Ryoujoku Nikki~
original_name: 監禁アイドルリサイタル～アイドル陵辱日記～
source:
Yuka-chan is an idol with small breasts, so she faces fierce competition in the world where big boobs rivals. Main character is a number one member of her fan-club. He learns about a secret thing between Yuka-chan and her manager, so protagonist abducts and confines the girl. This confinement life will go on until the girl realizes who her only true love is.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2020/07/vn-of-month-february-2008-switch-boku.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
小结花是一名胸部娇小的偶像，在巨乳当道的演艺圈里竞争得格外辛苦。主人公则是她的粉丝俱乐部头号会员。得知结花与经纪人之间不可告人的秘密后，他绑架并囚禁了少女。这段监禁生活将一直持续，直到她认清谁才是唯一真正爱自己的人。
